item.title: The IP Address Wasn’t the Interesting Part
item.author: Adam Rhys Heaton
item.description: Japan’s first confirmed DPRK IT-worker laptop-farm dismantling is useful for what it shows about shared infrastructure, operational dependencies, and the value of cross-stage contradiction.
